notes: All required story categories covered (schema, core logic, API integration, tests, integration hardening).

stories.title: Pydantic Input Validation Enforcement Layer
stories.description: Implement strict validation enforcement that binds incoming tool inputs to their corresponding Pydantic schemas, returning structured validation errors when inputs do not conform.

stories.title: Allowlist Security Enforcement
stories.description: Ensure only explicitly allowlisted tools can be executed by rejecting any tool ಹೆಸರು not present in the registry, with clear error handling and audit logging hooks.

stories.title: Tool Response Normalization and Formatting
stories.description: Standardize tool responses into a consistent structure for downstream consumption by the LLM loop, including success, error, and metadata fields.

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Inject relevant chat history into tool execution context where required, ensuring continuity of conversation and correct tool behavior across multi-turn interactions.
